name: Momo
source:
A girl with bear ears who is always full of energy.  She is very amicable and has a pure heart. She is an honest girl who expresses her happiness and sadness with her whole body. 

She is simple but also stubborn, and once she makes up her mind, she will not give in. She is exceptionally strong despite her appearance and can easily lift a large rock. She is sometimes a bit of a klutz.

[From [url=https://watakubi.com/islanddiary/]official site[/url]]
